note: Blind answer key v2. Revised (scoring/criteria only) before any extraction run on contract B; contract and extraction prompt unchanged. Never included in the extraction prompt. Do not edit after model output is seen. v1 kept for audit.
evaluated_against_coverage: Brightline Facility Services sample coverage (same COVERAGE object as the app)

in_scope_requirements.anchor: commercial general liability insurance with limits of not less than $2,000,000 per occurrence and $4,000,000 general aggregate
in_scope_requirements.test: Conflict. 1.3 says the more stringent requirement governs, so D.2 ($2M/$4M) controls over 12.2(a) ($1M/$2M).
in_scope_requirements.pass: FULL PASS only if either (a) the effective requirement is derived as $2,000,000 per occurrence / $4,000,000 aggregate AND Section 1.3 is recognized as making the stricter Exhibit D.2 govern AND both refs (12.2(a), D.2) are preserved; or (b) both conflicting clauses (12.2(a) and D.2) are surfaced AND the conflict is explicitly flagged for review.
in_scope_requirements.fail: Neither clause found, or only $1M/$2M extracted and treated as the governing requirement.
in_scope_requirements.partial: Only one clause found (either 12.2(a) alone or D.2 alone), or both found without the conflict/precedence being recognized.

in_scope_requirements.anchor: shall be included as additional insureds under Subcontractor’s commercial general liability policy with respect to liability arising out of Subcontractor’s work
in_scope_requirements.test: Ambiguous: 'arising out of Subcontractor's work' does not specify ongoing vs completed operations.
in_scope_requirements.pass: 12.4 is extracted AND the extraction preserves that ongoing vs completed operations is unspecified (does not assert a scope the text doesn't state) AND the requirement is not confidently marked Met unless the structured coverage data explicitly resolves that wording. Model confidence level is NOT itself scored.
in_scope_requirements.fail: Not extracted; or scope asserted as specific (e.g., ongoing only) as if the text said so; or marked Met although coverage data does not explicitly resolve the wording.

in_scope_requirements.anchor: shall obtain endorsements from its insurers waiving subrogation in favor of Contractor and Owner on each of those policies
in_scope_requirements.test: Lives in 10 Risk of Loss, not 12 Insurance.

in_scope_requirements.anchor: Subcontractor’s insurance shall be primary and non-contributory with respect to any insurance maintained by Contractor or Owner.

out_of_scope_requirements_must_be_surfac.key: General insurance conditions (authorized insurers; obtain before start, maintain thereafter)
out_of_scope_requirements_must_be_surfac.anchor: Before starting work, Subcontractor shall obtain and thereafter maintain the following insurance with insurers authorized to do business in the state where the Project is located.
out_of_scope_requirements_must_be_surfac.test: General condition, no comparison rule. Must be surfaced (in out_of_scope or as a noted condition), not dropped.

out_of_scope_requirements_must_be_surfac.anchor: Contractor’s pollution liability insurance with limits of not less than $2,000,000 per occurrence
out_of_scope_requirements_must_be_surfac.test: No comparison rule exists for pollution liability. Must not be silently dropped.

out_of_scope_requirements_must_be_surfac.anchor: Business automobile liability insurance with a combined single limit of not less than $1,000,000 per accident.
employer’s liability insurance with limits of not less than $1,000,000 each accident
Subcontractor shall furnish certificates of insurance and copies of the required endorsements to Contractor before starting work.
at least thirty (30) days’ prior written notice of cancellation

excess_allowed.condition: none or other (no follow-form condition stated)

external_references.key: Owner Controlled Insurance Program Manual (not provided)
external_references.anchor: Owner Controlled Insurance Program Manual issued by Owner, which is incorporated into this Agreement by reference

false_positive_traps.key: Equipment floater is recommended, not required
false_positive_traps.anchor: Contractor recommends, but does not require
false_positive_traps.fail: Appears as a requirement (in requirements or out_of_scope).

not_external: Exhibits A-D are attached per 1.2, so they are NOT missing external documents. Flagging them as missing counts as an extra.

stage_1_extraction.FOUND: Each in-scope item matched by type (+ line for limits); each out-of-scope item matched by its ref appearing in out_of_scope or requirements; external reference matched by ref 12.8.
stage_1_extraction.EXTRA: Any extracted requirement, out-of-scope item or external reference that matches no key item, including the 6.2 trap and any attached Exhibit (A-D) flagged as a missing external document.
stage_1_extraction.quality: Per found item: quote verified word-for-word in the contract; ref correct; values/conditions correct (GL per its pass/partial/fail; AI scope left unspecified; WOS lines cgl+auto+wc).
stage_1_extraction.special_criteria: GL conflict scored FULL / PARTIAL / FAIL per its criteria. AI ambiguity scored PASS / FAIL per its criteria.

stage_2_status_triage.rule: Scored separately, only for in-scope items found in stage 1, using the fixed sample coverage data. Status must fall within acceptable_status; correct_status is the ideal.
stage_2_status_triage.note: A stage-1 miss is not double-counted as a stage-2 failure; it is reported as 'not scorable'.

changes_from_v1: Added 12.1 (authorized insurers; obtain before starting work and maintain thereafter) as a scored out-of-scope general insurance condition.

Tightened GL conflict pass criterion: full pass only via (a) effective $2M/$4M with 1.3 precedence recognized and both refs preserved, or (b) both clauses surfaced with the conflict explicitly flagged. One clause only = partial.

Additional-insured ambiguity no longer requires medium/low model confidence; pass = 12.4 extracted, ongoing-vs-completed left unspecified, and not confidently Met unless coverage data explicitly resolves the wording.
Scoring split into Stage 1 (extraction) and Stage 2 (status/triage against fixed coverage data).
